prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (redesign, new_flow) with only 1 test each, though adoption redesign produced the only confirmed win.
Evidence is still thin for finish changes (copy, new_screen, notification, redesign) due to having only 1 test for each type.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in changes (copy, hint) and choose_path hint/redesign changes, as each has only 1 test so far.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Controls Screen: Add a dedicated controls onboarding screen right after home intro displaying interactive keybind tips and visibility toggles for the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet after onboarding, and the finish step drops to 64.8% conversion.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Delayed Sign In Flow Reorder: Move sign-in screen to take place right after adoption certificate and before waiting screen, allowing pet creation before account creation. (why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9% early in onboarding; moving it after pet customization builds user investment.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Data Sync Hint: Add an explicit account sync guarantee hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that pets remain saved on cloud login. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or reset after signing in again, making login reliability a key user concern.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Status Progress: Display explicit status text and progress time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop layers initialize. (why: Home waiting step has median duration 201s and 3 support emails reported pets failing to show up on desktop.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Notification Toggle: Enable optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet loading finishes. (why: The waiting step mean time is 2336s, indicating users minimize or abandon the desktop window while waiting.)
